title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Exodus 31: Bezalel and Oholiab, the Sabbath as a sign, and the two stone tablets.

questions.explanation: Yahweh called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Bezalel is called the son of Uri, the son of Hur.

questions.text: With what did God fill Bezalel?
questions.explanation: God filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, understanding, knowledge and all kinds of workmanship.

questions.text: Which skill is named among Bezalel's gifts?
questions.explanation: Bezalel was gifted to work in gold, silver and bronze, in cutting stones for setting and in carving wood.
God appointed with Bezalel Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

questions.text: The Sabbath was a sign so that Israel would know what?
questions.explanation: The Sabbath was a sign between God and Israel, so they would know that he is Yahweh who sanctifies them.

answers.text: That he is Yahweh who sanctifies them
That the harvest belonged to the priests
That the year has twelve months

questions.text: What was the penalty for doing work on the Sabbath day?
questions.explanation: Whoever did any work on the Sabbath day was surely to be put to death.

answers.text: He was surely to be put to death
He had to pay a fine
He had to fast for seven days
He had to stay outside the camp for a day

questions.text: According to verse 16, Israel was to keep the Sabbath as what?
questions.explanation: The children of Israel were to keep the Sabbath throughout their generations for a perpetual covenant.

questions.text: What reason does verse 17 give for the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: In six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.

answers.text: Israel came out of Egypt on the seventh day
Yahweh made heaven and earth in six days, then rested
The manna stopped falling on the seventh day
The tabernacle was finished on the seventh day

questions.text: How were the two stone tablets written?
questions.explanation: When God finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two stone tablets, written with God's finger.

answers.text: By Bezalel with an engraving tool
